title: Resolution urging Albany to expand design-build construction rules
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature and Governor to amend the New York City Public Works Investment Act to lower the dollar threshold for using design-build contracts. Currently city agencies can only use design-build for projects costing $10 million or more, or $1.2 million for agencies like Parks and NYCHA. Lowering the threshold would let more projects, such as prefabricated park toilets, use the faster design-build method.
